ae9a56ba.title: Solutions Architect - (Java + any Cloud)
ae9a56ba.description:
**About Vericence** 




 Vericence is a digital engineering and technology consulting firm helping enterprises build AI\-driven platforms, modernize legacy systems, and scale innovation through cloud, data, and intelligent engineering. We partner with global organizations to deliver high\-impact technology solutions and build world\-class engineering teams.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect with 15\+ years of software engineering experience and a strong background in designing and delivering enterprise\-scale Java\-based applications on cloud platforms. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strategic architecture leadership to define scalable, secure, and high\-performing solutions across complex enterprise environments.
 



 This role requires close collaboration with product, engineering, and client stakeholders to establish solution blueprints, drive architecture decisions, oversee integrations, and ensure successful delivery across multiple engineering teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Define and own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for enterprise Java applications across multiple business modules.
* Establish architecture standards, design principles, implementation guidelines, and best practices for scalable and maintainable software solutions.
* Lead architecture reviews, evaluate technical trade\-offs, and ensure alignment across development teams.
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and technical leads to translate business requirements into scalable solution designs.
* Design and oversee enterprise integrations using REST APIs, messaging platforms, and event\-driven architectures.
* Guide implementation teams on architecture, performance optimization, security, and scalability best practices.
* Establish governance around observability, logging, monitoring, security, and compliance across cloud\-native applications.
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to communicate solution direction, implementation strategy, and technical risks.
* Drive proof\-of\-concepts for emerging Java frameworks, cloud\-native technologies, and modernization initiatives.
* Mentor engineering teams and promote architecture excellence across multiple concurrent projects.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 15\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5 years in Solution Architect or Technical Architecture leadership roles.
* Deep expertise in designing and modernizing large\-scale distributed systems, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and enterprise application development.
* Extensive experience designing RESTful APIs and enterprise integration solutions.
* Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment.
* Experience with messaging and streaming technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar platforms.
* Engage with executive stakeholders to communicate roadmap direction and roadmap risks.
* Drive proof\-of\-concepts for emerging AI/ML capabilities and evaluate their production readiness.
* Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, including performance optimization and data architecture.
* Proven experience leading solution architecture across multiple engineering teams and enterprise transformation programs.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive leadership.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar tools).
* Familiarity with API Gateway, service mesh, and cloud\-native observability tools.
* Experience integrating with enterprise platforms such as Jira, GitHub, Bitbucket, or other ALM tools.

* Experience in Healthcare, Retail, Financial Services, or Enterprise SaaS environments is highly desirable.

c7bb603e.title: Solution Specialist, Finance Systems
c7bb603e.description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
 Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle\-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
 Grabber Technology Solutions (GTS) aims to be a technology leader that provides predictive and seamless experiences to all Grab employees (Grabbers). We are a diverse team of technology practitioners looking to outserve Grabbers with positive, personalised IT experiences, and we are looking for individuals with similar customer\-centric and values to join our growing team.
   

  

**Get to Know the Role**
 The Senior Solution Specialist will report directly to the Delivery Manager for Finance Systems. As a
 **Solution Specialist, Finance Systems** 
 , you will work with GTS teams and Finance users to understand challenges, current processes and system requirements. You will translate these needs into future\-state application requirements, process improvements and solution designs, working with other teams and external implementation partners where required.
   

  

 You will focus on managing change requests and project implementations within the
 **Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP** 
 environment, with an emphasis on
 **Record\-to\-Report (R2R)** 
 processes. Experience in Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) and Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) will be an advantage.
   

  

**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**
* Lead Finance Systems change requests and project implementations from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, deployment and post\-go\-live stabilisation.
* Collaborate with Finance partners to understand needs, document all\-state processes, standardise requirements and perform fit\-gap analysis.
* Translate requirements into functional solution designs, configuration recommendations, process improvements and implementation plans.
* Assess the impact, risks, dependencies and priorities of proposed changes across finance processes, data, integrations and related applications.
* Coordinate System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect resolution, test\-result validation and business approval.
* Work with technical teams, Oracle Support, implementation partners and Finance partners to deliver integrations, data migrations, enhancements, releases and quarterly Oracle Fusion Cloud upgrades.
* Evaluate new Oracle platform capabilities and conduct Proofs of Concept (POCs) to assess feasibility, value and agreement on Finance requirements.
* Drive change adoption through process documentation, user guides, training materials, partner communication, knowledge transfer and continuous improvement of R2R processes.


**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**
* At least 3\+ years of experience working with Oracle ERP Cloud applications, including knowledge of module interactions and integrations with third\-party applications.
* Experience managing at least two full lifecycle Oracle ERP Cloud projects, including delivery of R2R solutions.
* Knowledge of Oracle Finance Cloud, General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Intercompany and Tax. We prefer a working knowledge of Receivables and Payables.
* Experience with the change lifecycle, including configuration or development, SIT, UAT, release packaging, deployment and post\-go\-live support.
* Experience preparing functional design documents, process documentation, user guides and training materials.
* Analyse impacts and identify how a system change may affect related processes, data points, integrations and controls.
* Partner management, with the ability to explain solution options and recommendations to business and technical audiences.


**Good to Have**
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle Procurement Cloud and Order Management Cloud.
* Knowledge or experience with Oracle EPM and Master Data Management (MDM).
* Experience with financial reporting tools such as Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) and Business Intelligence (BI).
* Experience with other Finance systems such as Concur or Kyriba.
* Experience working in a global or international business environment.
* Experience with Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and other automation solutions.


**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
 We care about your well\-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
   

  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love\-all\-Serve\-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours


**What We Stand For At Grab**
 We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

5b0c39c4.title: Associate Technology Program Manager â€“ Global Supply Chain
5b0c39c4.description:
### **So, What's the Story?**


Dr. Martens is entering a transformative phase in its global supply chain technology landscape. We are building a connected, intelligent digital ecosystem spanning planning, product lifecycle management, sourcing and costing, quality, and logistics, powered by platforms including Blue Yonder SCPO, FlexPLM, and Microsoft D365 Supply Chain Management, alongside a growing portfolio of specialist and custom applications.


We are looking for an accomplished Associate Technology Program Manager, based in our Bengaluru Global Technology Centre (GTC), to own technology intake and delivery for Global Supply Chain. This role is the connective tissue between multiple senior business stakeholders and the technology teams that build and support their systems, translating ambition into scoped, funded, governed, and delivered programmes of work.


Above all, this role puts culture at the centre of how work gets done. We are looking for someone who leads with respect, shows genuine care for the people and outcomes they are accountable for, and brings the persistence to follow every delivery risk through to resolution, not just to the next status report.


This role reports into the Technology Director – Global Supply Chain \& Finance and works closely with the wider Global Technology team and senior supply chain business stakeholders across Materials, Sourcing, Global Logistics, Operations, End\-to\-End Planning, Product Quality, and Sustainability.

  

  

### **The Gig**


#### **Role Purpose**


As Associate Technology Program Manager, you will own the intake, prioritisation, and delivery of technology change across Global Supply Chain, acting as a single, trusted point of contact for business stakeholders while driving disciplined technology PMO practice, rigorous budget management, and software purchase order (PO) governance across your programme of work. You bring the persistence to chase down delivery risks until they are genuinely closed, not just logged.

  

  

#### **Key Stakeholder Partnerships**


You will work across a wide senior stakeholder group to shape and deliver the technology intake pipeline, including heads of:


* Materials


* Sourcing


* Global Logistics


* Operations


* End\-to\-End Planning


* Product Quality


You will support technology leadership by building genuinely collaborative, respectful relationships with each of these stakeholders, understanding their priorities, translating them into technology intake, and being a dependable, honest voice on progress, cost, and risk.

  

  

#### **Main Responsibilities**


* Own end\-to\-end technology intake for Global Supply Chain: capture demand from business stakeholders, qualify scope and business value, and prioritise against capacity and strategic goals.


* Champion strong technology PMO practices across your portfolio, including governance cadences, RAID logs, stage gates, reporting standards, and lessons learned, so delivery is consistent, transparent, and auditable.


* Own programme and project budgets end to end: build estimates, set baselines, track actuals against forecast, explain variances, and take corrective action early.


* Manage software purchase orders and vendor spend, ensuring POs are raised, tracked, and reconciled accurately against contracts and delivery milestones.


* Identify, own, and relentlessly follow through on technology delivery risks and issues, escalating early, chasing resolution with persistence, and never letting a risk go quiet just because it is uncomfortable.


* Define scope, objectives, success metrics, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders, and maintain comprehensive plans covering schedule, resources, and dependencies.


* Facilitate cross\-team collaboration and manage dependencies across the supply chain systems landscape and the wider technology portfolio.


* Lead agile or hybrid delivery approaches as appropriate, ensuring effective backlog management and well\-run ceremonies.


* Ensure quality, security, performance, and scalability requirements are met before go\-live.


* Provide clear, honest, regular status updates to business stakeholders and executive sponsors, covering financials, risk, and outcomes in language every audience can act on.


* Model our culture in every interaction: treat colleagues, vendors, and stakeholders with respect, show that you care about the outcome and about the people delivering it, and build trust through consistency and follow\-through.

  

  

#### **Technology Landscape You'll Work Across**


Your programme portfolio spans a broad and evolving set of platforms, including:


* FlexPLM – product lifecycle management


* Blue Yonder SCPO – supply chain planning and optimisation


* Microsoft D365 Supply Chain Management – core ERP and supply chain operations


* Tradelink One and other specialist trade and logistics applications


* Pivot88 – quality management system (QMS)


* PPM – custom\-built program and portfolio management application


* The Global Supply Chain Data Program, covering B2B customer master data and master data management (MDM) for product and location, which underpins data quality across the wider supply chain estate


You do not need to be the engineer writing the code or the pipeline, but you do need to understand, at a working level, how end\-to\-end integrations are architected, how data engineering pipelines move and transform data, and how UI/UX decisions affect adoption, enough to ask the right questions, spot risk early, and hold technical teams to account.

  

  

### **The Stuff That Sets You Apart**


#### **Experience \& Skills**


**Must\-Haves:**

* 10–12 years of overall technology experience, with high professional maturity and executive presence.


* 5–7 years of hands\-on technology development experience (engineering, integration, or data), having since progressed into programme or project management.


* Proven track record delivering technology programmes in retail, supply chain, or ERP environments.


* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end integrations, data engineering pipelines, and UI/UX principles, with the judgement to apply that understanding to delivery risk and quality decisions.


* Demonstrated experience in technology PMO practice: governance, reporting, RAID management, and portfolio\-level planning.


* Hands\-on experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial tracking, variance analysis, and software PO / vendor spend management.


* Comprehensive understanding of Agile and/or hybrid delivery methodologies.


* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, able to build trust and communicate complex technical and financial matters clearly to senior, non\-technical executives.


* Experience working across global, multi\-region teams, including managing localisation and regulatory variation.


**Nice\-to\-Have:**

* Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, or SAFe.


* Direct experience with any of FlexPLM, Blue Yonder, D365 Supply Chain Management, or Supply chain QMS platforms.


* Experience with master data management (MDM) or B2B data integration programmes.

  

  

#### **Soft Skills \& Culture**


* Leads with respect and genuine care, for stakeholders, for the team, and for the outcome.


* Persistent and tenacious in following technology delivery risks through to closure, without needing to be chased.


* Confident, warm, and credible with senior executives, including COO\-level stakeholders.


* High emotional intelligence; builds trust quickly across business, technical, and vendor teams.


* Calm and solution\-focused under pressure and shifting priorities.


* Commercially disciplined, understanding the business impact of every delivery and spend decision.


* Proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes.


* Strategic thinker who connects programme goals to wider business objectives.

  

  

### **At DM, your technical ability will go hand in hand with our leadership characteristics:**


* Inspire people: share a vision and plan linked to our strategy; make people feel they are part of something bigger; grow your people's confidence and capacity through coaching and development.


* Think like a custodian: think and act strategically about the long\-term health of DM; make courageous decisions to grow and protect the brand; leave DMs in a better place for consumers and the next generation of leaders.


* Build connections: form authentic collaborative relationships; build self, talent, diverse \& inclusive teams and partnerships; create space to have open and honest discussions with your team and peers.


* Deliver results: empower and hold yourself and your people accountable; create a safe environment to drive performance and progress, not perfection; be agile, find solutions and deliver with integrity.

3e8e7686.title: Technical Architect
3e8e7686.description:
**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Technical Architect for our Quality Control (QC) team in Ubisoft Pune. As an individual contributor, you will work closely with two Programming Leads to design, plan, and develop scalable and sustainable Automation solutions for our games. Additionally, you will act as the Technical Point of Contact (POC), representing the QC Tech. team in discussions with global technical leaders across the organization.
   

  

**Job Duties / Responsibilities Core Responsibilities**
* Automation Solutions Design: Identify and implement the most suitable technologies to solve QC challenges and improve efficiency.
* Requirements Analysis: Collaborate with Product teams to understand business problems and translate them into functional and technical requirements.
* Architecture Development: Perform architecture analysis to derive non\-functional requirements, ensuring performance, scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Framework \& Standards: Design and document system architecture, interfaces, and frameworks for automation solutions, ensuring long\-term sustainability.
* Technical Guidance: Guide Programming Leads and teams in implementing frameworks and adhering to architecture best practices.
* Technology Evaluation: Propose and validate technology solutions for automation challenges, including proof\-of\-concept (POC) development.
* Code Quality: Conduct code reviews and promote best practices to ensure high quality, maintainable code.
* Collaboration: Work closely with Programming Leads and Project Managers to define team composition, effort estimates, and execution strategies.
* Problem Resolution: Troubleshoot technical issues and provide expert guidance to teams as needed.
* Training Plans: Creating a long\-term training plan for the Tech. teams for core technical trainings and work closely with L\&D Manager to ensure execution.


**Global Technical Leadership Responsibilities**
* Technical POC: Represent the QC team in global technical discussions, aligning QC solutions with organizational goals and ensuring cross\-team collaboration.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build strong relationships with global tech leaders, ensuring QC automation efforts are integrated into the broader tech ecosystem.
* Knowledge Sharing: Act as a bridge between global and local tech teams, sharing best practices, emerging trends, and new technologies.

**Core Competencies**

ddc24db7.description:

* Leading AI\-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions Software Product Company and one of Glassdoor’s “Best Places to Work”
* We are seeking an astute and enthusiastic individual who has a strong technical foundation with the additional ability to be hands\-on with the Professional Services team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to lead and implement independently working with both the platform, and the solution teams.


**Scope**
* The Professional services team within Blue Yonder operates globally and is growing rapidly.
* Blue Yonder Enterprise Technical Architect (Planning) will be responsible for services delivery of product implementation and related integration.
* This role will provide the associate to be hands\-on with the Professional Services team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to implement them working with both the platform, and the solution teams.

* OS – Windows, Unix
* DB – RDBMS Concepts, Oracle, MS SQL Server, SQL/ PL SQL
* Implementation experience using SCPO Platform or any other relevant enterprise planning product and platforms.

* Ready to travel to customer sites based on business needs.
* Identify areas of improvement and scope of automation on routine tasks or activities
* Handle activities with a diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors.
* Accelerate Time\-to\-Value for customer by iteratively delivering in short cycles.
* Recognize and highlight incremental revenue opportunities within existing customer projects.
* Ensures compliance with the internal and external company policies and procedures.


**What We Are Looking For**

0e0a9406.title: Program Manager - ACoE
0e0a9406.description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Power Limited (APL):** 
 Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India.We have a power generation capacity of 15,250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 This role is responsible for overseeing and managing all operational aspects related to analytics and business integration at the site level within Adani Power Limited. This role focuses on coordinating project management activities, stakeholder engagement, solution deployment, and vendor management to ensure effective implementation of analytics solutions and operational excellence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Program Manager**
**Operations And Stakeholder Management**
 Ensure smooth on\-ground operations at the site, overseeing daily activities to maintain operational efficiency.
   

  

 Manage and optimize the financial budget allocated for site operations, ensuring resources are allocated effectively.
   

  

 Build strong relationships with site Heads of Departments (HODs) to identify opportunities for applying analytics to enhance operational effectiveness.
   

  

 Prioritize areas identified for analytics application based on business impact and strategic alignment.
   

  

 Maintain regular communication with leadership to provide updates on site activities and project progress.
   

  

**Awareness And Training**
 Promote awareness of analytics capabilities and organize learning or training programs at the site to enhance team members' skills and knowledge.
   

  

 Coordinate with relevant departments to implement training programs effectively, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
   

  

**Business And Analytics Integration**
 Develop a deep understanding of plant operations, business processes, and opportunities for analytics applications.
   

  

 Participate in site\-level meetings to identify business challenges and collaborate with Business Analysts to develop detailed solutions.
   

  

 Ensure successful implementation of analytics solutions at the site, driving adoption and acceptance among stakeholders.
   

  

**Solution Deployment**
 Review and validate solutions developed by the analytics team, ensuring they meet business requirements and quality standards.
   

  

 Collaborate with the Portfolio Manager to deploy successful initiatives and best practices across other sites within Adani Power Limited.
   

  

 Manage the deployment of solutions, coordinating inputs and feedback from the Portfolio Manager and stakeholders.
   

  

**Vendor And Project Management**
 Manage vendor\-related activities for on\-site operations, including vendor identification, engagement, negotiations, and relationship management.
   

  

 Ensure vendors deliver quality services and products in alignment with project requirements and timelines.
   

  

 Coordinate various aspects of project management at the site, including planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and risk management.
   

  

 Ensure adherence to quality standards, processes, and consistency in project execution across the site.
   

  

 Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among team members and stakeholders to achieve project goals.
   

  

**Training And Development**
 Identify training needs and opportunities within the plant to enhance skills and knowledge relevant to project and operational requirements.
   

  

 Develop project charters for business problems, define project plans, and oversee their execution to achieve desired outcomes.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Plant Teams
   

  

 Projects Team
   

  

 Leadership
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Vendors
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 B.E./ B.Tech (Mechanical, Power Engineering or a related core discipline)
   

  

**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
 Minimum of 9 years of industry experience, preferably in a plant\-based role.
   

  

**Preferred Industry**
 Background in power utilities or similar sectors with significant exposure to project management and analytics

50c4936c.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Job description
  
The Senior Solution Architect focuses on designing business\-driven, standards\-based, and future\-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non\-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.
  
Description of the area
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non\-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.
* Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual\& Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded and published for multiple solutions or the product. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments.
* Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product.
* Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.
* Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.
* Business / Technical ability: Applies in\-depth and expert\-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.


Qualifications
  
Education / Experience
  
  

* Demonstrated experience designing business\-driven, standards\-based, future\-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context.
* Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes.
* Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others.


•
  
  

Technical Skills
  
  

* In\-depth and expert\-level knowledge in multiple technology areas.
* Proficiency in creating Conceptual\& Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for products.
* Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions.
* Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for multiple solutions, including conducting vendor assessments.


Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to communicate difficult concepts and influence stakeholders to adopt different perspectives.
* Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value, improve existing solutions, manage technical debt, and lead teams in identifying innovative solutions.

efeb4c7a.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
efeb4c7a.description:
NVIDIA's Connectivity Software team seeks a skilled and experienced technical program manager to help deliver on NVIDIA's inspiring product roadmap! The software produced by this team include foundational kernel components, drivers, and firmware that support the entire family of NVIDIA chipsets. Join an excellent team and help guide NVIDIA's future!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 You will collaborate with the team and peers across the company to build, represent and carry out detailed plans for delivering the team's work. In particular, you will have the opportunity to:
   

  

* Work on aligning NVIDIA's SoC and product roadmap with the software team capacity roadmap and help balance global priorities
* Keep the team on track by coordinating dependencies across functional areas and identifying planning gaps
* Be empowered to make prioritization decisions and represent the team to other groups
* Collaborate closely with hardware, release planning, customers, and industry partners giving you a complete picture of software at NVIDIA
* Propose and develop new methods to handle projects and unify planning systems
* Define and track metrics to improve execution efficiency
* Manage technical and program\-level interactions with external partners and vendors, ensuring alignment on requirements, dependencies, schedules, and deliverables.


**What We Need To See**
* 8\+ overall years of program management experience in delivering software products.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or similar field or equivalent experience
* Proven track record of balancing short\-term delivery towards critical timelines alongside thoughtful long\-term steps towards improving planning, processes, and team capabilities.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Knowledge of SOC, IO peripherals or CPU project management
* Past experience as a software developer
* Background in Networking protocols, PCIe, USB, machine learning, or accelerated computing
* Experience with software productivity tools and process automation


 With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the most desirable employers in the world. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you are creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

34363038.description:
**SURYA AT A GLANCE** 
 Surya creates software products and provides implementation services for financial risk management of banks and the financial services industry. We provide web\-based, shared facility treasury management products for corporates. Founded in 1999, Surya’s client base is spread across four continents. We help more than 75\+ banks, hedge funds, and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability, and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in Dubai, UK, USA and France.
   

  

* Designation: Pre\-Sales Consultant
* Relevant Experience: 2 \- 4 Years
* Qualification: MBA (Finance/Banking), CA, CFA, FRM, B.Com, M.Com, BBM, BE/B.Tech or equivalent qualification


**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As a Pre\-Sales Consultant, you will support business development and sales engagements by understanding client requirements, positioning Surya’s solutions, and demonstrating the value of our products to banks, financial institutions, and corporate customers. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams across the complete sales lifecycle.
   

  

* Attend client requirement discussions and understand business, functional, and solution needs.
* Conduct product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, workshops, and presentations for prospective customers.
* Prepare and submit responses for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and other proposal\-related documentation.
* Prepare solution decks, product write\-ups, proposal content, business presentations, and customer\-facing collateral.
* Provide content support for certifications, ratings, analyst questionnaires, industry assessments, and related submissions.
* Work collaboratively with Field Sales, Sales Operations, Inside Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to support sales opportunities.
* Assist in solution positioning, proposal preparation, proof\-of\-concept discussions, and customer clarifications.
* Stay updated on banking, financial risk management, regulatory developments, and competitive product offerings.
* Travel to customer locations for meetings, demonstrations, workshops, and business development activities as required


**Required Skills**
*Functional*
* Good understanding of banking and financial services industry.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and map them to product capabilities.
* Exposure to Treasury, ALM, Liquidity Risk, Market Risk, IRRBB, FTP, Basel II/III, Stress Testing, or related risk management areas is desirable.
* Ability to prepare customer\-facing solution proposals, presentations, and business write\-ups.


*Technical*
* Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word – Mandatory.
* Ability to create clear solution decks, product collateral, and proposal documents.
* SQL basics and understanding of databases – Good to have.
* Understanding of enterprise software products and implementation lifecycle is an added advantage.


**Other Essential Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation, listening, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively across multiple teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Flexible and positive approach to work with willingness to travel based on business requirements.


**Preferred Experience**
* Prior experience in software product pre\-sales, solution consulting, business consulting, or client\-facing product demonstrations.
* Prior exposure to Financial Risk Management products or banking product pre\-sales will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, fintech organizations, or enterprise software companies is preferred

Overview:
**About Vista Equity Partners**


Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology\-enabled businesses. With over **$100B in assets under** management and a portfolio of **90\+ software product companies worldwide**, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long\-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with **45\+ portfolio companies** employing more than **17,000 professionals** across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.


Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision\-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio\-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.

**Xactly**, a Vista\-backed organization since 2017, is a leader in **Sales Performance Management Solutions**, The Xactly Intelligent Revenue Platform helps businesses improve go\-to\-market outcomes through increased collaboration, greater efficiencies, and connecting data from all critical functions of the revenue lifecycle on a single platform. Born in the cloud almost 20 years ago, Xactly provides customers with extensive experience in solving the most challenging problems customers of all sizes face, backed by almost 20 years of proprietary data and award\-winning AI.


Named among the best workplaces in the U.S. by Great Place to Work six times, honored on FORTUNE Magazine’s inaugural list of the 100 Best Workplaces for Millennials, and chosen as the “Market Leader in Incentive Compensation” by CRM magazine. We’re building a culture of success and are looking for motivated professionals to join us!


With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growth\-stage company with the scale, stability, and career opportunities of a global technology network. Our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate, and build meaningful solutions that drive measurable outcomes for customers worldwide.

**Our Employee Value Proposition (EVP)**


At **Xactly**, our people are our greatest advantage. Our Employee Value Proposition reflects what we stand for and the experience we create for every team member:

* **Purpose:** to empower businesses to maximize company performance by transforming sales through their AI\-powered Intelligent Revenue Platform, focusing on aligned incentive compensation, data\-driven insights, and seamless revenue management for finance, sales, and revenue teams
* **Growth:** centered on "unleashing human potential" to elevate company performance and empowering employees to "achieve enduring success" through professional development, a supportive culture, and aligning individual goals with company objectives.
* **Culture:** We’re passionate about cultivating a workplace environment that celebrates the uniqueness of each Xactlian. Diversity fuels our success and by embracing it, we empower our employees around the world to inspire change in the office and in the community.
* **Innovation:** Xactly's innovation is centered on its AI\-powered Intelligent Revenue Platform, which unifies sales performance management (SPM) and revenue intelligence using over two decades of proprietary pay and performance data. d5178dbf.title: Cloud Engineer
d5178dbf.description:
**About The Company**
 HCLTech is a leading global technology company dedicated to delivering innovative IT solutions and services to clients across various industries. With a rich history of technological excellence and a commitment to transforming businesses, HCLTech specializes in digital transformation, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and enterprise modernization. The company prides itself on fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment, empowering its employees to drive change and deliver value to customers worldwide. HCLTech’s extensive global presence and strategic partnerships enable it to stay at the forefront of technological advancements and industry trends, making it a trusted partner for organizations seeking to harness the power of technology for growth and innovation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 HCLTech is seeking a highly skilled Google Cloud Solutions Engineer / Architect to join our dynamic team across India. This role is pivotal in designing and engineering cloud solutions that accelerate the adoption of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) at the enterprise level. As a Solutions Engineer / Architect, you will lead the development of innovative cloud migration, modernization, data engineering, and AI\-driven automation solutions tailored to Fortune 2000 clients. Your expertise will enable organizations to optimize their cloud investments, streamline operations, and leverage cutting\-edge technologies such as BigQuery, Looker, Vertex AI, and GenAI to achieve their strategic objectives.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with global sales teams, technical architects, and industry partners to craft compelling go\-to\-market strategies. You will be responsible for creating solution approaches, differentiators, and benefits that align with customer needs across industries like banking, retail, healthcare, and telecom. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on high\-impact projects that shape the future of enterprise cloud adoption and AI innovation.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will possess a B.E. / B.Tech degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields. Candidates should have between 5 to 7 years of overall IT experience, with at least 2\-3 years specifically working on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Demonstrated proficiency in GCP core services such as compute, storage, and networking is essential. Additionally, expertise in data engineering technologies like BigQuery and Looker, along with a foundational understanding of AI/ML platforms such as Vertex AI and Gemini Enterprise, is highly desirable. Proven experience collaborating with GSI partners and a high level of industry domain knowledge in sectors such as BFSI, RCPG, telecom, healthcare, or manufacturing will be advantageous. Strong soft skills including executive presence, whiteboarding, and the ability to translate technical concepts into business value are critical for success in this role.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with global sales teams and Google Cloud Architects to respond to RFIs and RFPs, ensuring tailored solutions meet customer requirements.
* Develop ROI models and hyperscale funding strategies to demonstrate TCO benefits and drive cloud adoption.
* Design industry\-specific use cases for IT managed services, focusing on cloud modernization and migration strategies.
* Lead technical workshops and create reference architectures for data center migration and modernization initiatives to Google Cloud.
* Design and implement Google Cloud native applications and enterprise\-grade data engineering stacks utilizing BigQuery, Looker, and Vertex AI.
* Innovate and develop Gemini Enterprise AI and GenAI solutions aligned with enterprise needs, facilitating automation and operational efficiency.
* Partner with GSI and industry stakeholders to build joint solutions, scale go\-to\-market efforts, and expand cloud footprint within targeted industries.
* Maintain a deep understanding of industry\-specific value streams and use cases, applying this knowledge to solution design.


**Benefits**
 HCLTech offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well\-being and professional growth of its employees. This includes competitive salary packages, performance\-based incentives, and health insurance coverage. Employees also have access to continuous learning and development programs, certifications, and career advancement opportunities within a global organization. HCLTech promotes a collaborative work environment with flexible work arrangements, recognizing the importance of work\-life balance. Additionally, employees benefit from exposure to cutting\-edge technologies and innovative projects that foster professional expertise and personal growth.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 HCLTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our mission to innovate and transform industries through technology.

6d39bbba.title: Technical Lead / Solution Architect
6d39bbba.description:
The role
   

  

 You are the person every merge goes through. You own the service contracts that the whole team builds against, you sign the contract freeze, and you command incidents from your first week. In your third week you induct nine engineers who all arrive on the same morning, having yourself been in the building for ten working days.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Own the seven API service contracts, draft them by the end of August and sign the freeze with all fifteen seats present
* Approve every merge to main — no exceptions, not for a one\-line fix, not at eleven at night
* Require two\-person review on settlement and payments, with no exception for hot fixes
* Hold review turnaround at 24 hours, and at 6 hours on the money and dispatch paths
* Own the architecture decision log, release and rollback calls, incident triage and post\-incident reviews
* Run the engineering track of the induction week and get all nine joiners to a merged commit by the Friday
* Share the on\-call rota with DevOps — one week on, two weeks off


 Eligibility
   

  

* Eight to ten years in backend engineering, at least three of them leading a team or owning a critical service
* Depth in Java and strong SQL on a Postgres\-class database, plus enough Python to review it
* You have designed and versioned API contracts that other teams built against
* You have run real incidents and written the reviews afterwards
* You have onboarded a group, not just an individual — this seat inducts nine people in its third week


 What you get
   

  

* Seven services and fifteen engineers, from the first line of code
* A daily working relationship with the CTO, and the authority that goes with the seat


 How the process runs
   

  

* Fill in the short form on this page.
* We read it ourselves. Every application is read.
* If we want to meet you, we call you.

2b8a3659.title: Reflections Info Systems - Senior Solution Architect - Distributed Systems
2b8a3659.description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for a highly experienced Solution Architect with 15\+ years of overall IT experience to provide end\-to\-end technical leadership, solution architecture, and delivery guidance across the project.
   

  

**Primary Skills**
* 15\+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience in Solution Architecture / Technical Architecture roles.
* Strong experience in enterprise solution architecture and system design.
* Extensive experience with microservices, distributed systems, and modern application architectures.
* Strong knowledge of API design, REST APIs, integration patterns, and enterprise integrations.
* Strong experience designing and implementing solutions on AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
* Strong understanding of modern architecture patterns, principles, and best practices.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AI, Generative AI, LLM\-based applications, and Agentic AI.
* Experience designing or implementing AI agents, agent orchestration, AI workflows, tool integration, and enterprise AI solutions.
* Understanding of integrating AI/ML capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and cloud services.
* Experience with databases, data integration, messaging, and enterprise application architecture.
* Strong understanding of security, scalability, availability, performance, resiliency, and observability.
* Experience with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and modern software engineering methodologies.
* Ability to assess existing architectures and recommend practical improvements.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.


**Responsibilities**
* Provide end\-to\-end solution architecture and technical leadership for the project.
* Take ownership of the overall technical solution, architecture decisions, technology choices, and technical roadmap.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into scalable, secure, maintainable, and enterprise\-grade technical solutions.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical direction, guidance, and mentorship to developers and engineers.
* Review and validate technical designs, architecture documents, integration approaches, and implementation strategies.
* Drive architecture discussions and provide recommendations on technology choices, design patterns, integration approaches, and technical trade\-offs.
* Design and evaluate solutions leveraging AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI to improve business processes, automation, productivity, and application capabilities.

**Job Description**
 The Senior Cloud Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, operating, and optimizing cloud platform services. These services must be secure, scalable, and automated. The primary focus is on Microsoft Azure, but the environment spans multiple clouds, including AWS and GCP. You will lead complex technical programs, advances reusable architecture patterns, and strengthen automation and governance practices across assigned platform domains. The Senior Engineer also mentors mid\-level engineers and partners with cross\-functional teams. This ensures that cloud platforms are reliable, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards and operational goals. You will report to a Manager.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Design, implement, and improve cloud platform services with a primary focus on Azure, supporting multi\-cloud integrations with AWS and GCP where required.
* Lead complex platform programs across compute, networking, identity, and storage domains, ensuring reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.
* Develop infrastructure\-as\-code solutions using Azure Resource Manager (ARM/Bicep), Terraform, and related frameworks across multiple environments.
* Standardize and improve cloud platform configurations, automation workflows, and deployment pipelines to align with enterprise standards.
* You will improve observability, proactive monitoring, self\-healing capabilities, and incident reduction across platform services.
* You will lead advanced troubleshooting and incident response efforts, conducting structured root cause analysis and implementing long\-term remediation.
* Implement cloud policies, governance controls, and security configurations within Azure and extending equivalent governance and security controls to AWS and GCP.
* Support and guide cloud migration and modernization efforts, including workload onboarding, tenant integration, and hybrid connectivity patterns across Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Collaborate with application, security, networking, and business teams to support cloud adoption, resolve complex issues, and improve platform usability.
* Mentor Level 2 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and operational guidance.


**Summary Of Primary Responsibilities**
* Design reusable infrastructure\-as\-code modules and automation frameworks aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
* Implement and support Azure\-native services and configurations, including:
+ Virtual Networks (VNets), peering, gateways, and ExpressRoute
+ Hub\-and\-spoke architectures and private endpoint configurations
+ Azure DNS (private zones, resolvers, custom configurations)
+ Azure Entra (identity, role assignments, multi\-tenant configurations, application registrations)
+ Azure Policy (definition, assignment, and enforcement)

* Ensure availability, performance, and reliability of cloud platform services, including compute, storage, networking, and backup capabilities.
* Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and Azure CLI/SDK tooling.
* Improve deployment processes and platform manageability using Azure DevOps and related CI/CD tooling.
* Support integration with enterprise systems, including RESTful services, identity providers, and third\-party vendor solutions.
* Contribute to cost awareness and operational efficiency by supporting resource optimization and understanding Azure billing constructs (subscriptions, billing scopes, enterprise agreements).
* Maintain technical documentation, reference implementations, and operational runbooks.


**Qualifications**
* 5–9 years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or platform engineering within enterprise environments.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure as a primary platform, including deployment, configuration, and operations across enterprise\-scale environments.
* Proficiency in infrastructure\-as\-code using ARM/Bicep, Terraform, or equivalent frameworks, including multi\-environment deployments.
* 5\+ years experience with Azure networking architectures, including VNets, routing, DNS, hybrid connectivity, and distributed system design.
* 3\+ years of experience with Azure identity and access management, including Entra ID, role\-based access control, multi\-tenant configurations, and policy enforcement.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and cloud provider CLI/SDK tools.
* Experience with Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD platforms supporting automated cloud deployments.
* Working knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows operating systems in cloud environments.
* Understanding of core networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP) and their application in distributed cloud systems.
* 3\+ years of experience supporting cloud migration initiatives and integrating on\-premises or multi\-tenant environments into Azure.
* Knowledge of enterprise cybersecurity practices, risk management processes, and incident response methodologies.
* You will operate independently, lead complex technical efforts, and influence partners.
* We strongly prefer Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-104, AZ\-305, AZ\-400\); we value AWS/GCP certifications given the multi\-cloud scope of this role.


**Additional Information**
 Our uniqueness is that we truly celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what truly matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, engagement, collaboration, wellness, reward \& recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's strong people first approach is award winning; Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, FORTUNE Best Companies to work and Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globally 4\.4 Stars) to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.
   

  

 Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, color, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
   

  

 Experian Careers \- Creating a better tomorrow together
   

  

**Benefits**

21521f4c.title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
21521f4c.description:
The role
   

  

 You stand up and hold the entire estate: the production node, the pipelines that reach it, the observability that explains it, and a restore that has actually been performed rather than described. You also build fifteen workstations before nine people arrive on the same morning.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Provision and harden production, and own database, cache and application deployment
* Build continuous delivery with automatic rollback — every merge tested, built and deployed to staging in ten minutes or less
* Own backup and disaster recovery to a four\-hour restore and fifteen minutes of acceptable data loss
* Run a restore drill every month from September, each producing a filed evidence record
* Deliver observability in week one: structured logs correlated by job, metrics on gate and settlement variance, alerts that mean something
* Build and sign into fifteen complete workstations before the second wave arrives — a hard gate
* Write every procedure as a runbook somebody else could follow at two in the morning


 Eligibility
   

  

* Four to six years in infrastructure, with a dedicated or bare\-metal estate managed solo for two years or more
* Postgres\-class database operations: backups, restores, replication, tuning
* A pipeline you built from nothing, including stabilising the flaky tests
* Disaster\-recovery drills you personally ran, with a story about what failed the first time
* Monitoring built from scratch rather than bought as a bundle
* Cost awareness, and the instinct to read the exit clause before the price


 What you get
   

  

* The whole estate, yours to design — hosting chosen on cost and exit terms, with no lock\-in accepted
* A company that treats a rehearsed restore as the job, not as paperwork


 How the process runs
   

  

* Fill in the short form on this page.
* We read it ourselves. Every application is read.
* If we want to meet you, we call you.

18f93e0b.title: Cloud Engineer
18f93e0b.description:
**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a proactive and self\-driven Cloud Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure Services (CIS) team. In this role, you will take ownership of the design, implementation, and automation of our cloud infrastructure, with a primary focus on AWS and GCP. We need an engineer who can work independently, make technical decisions, and drive projects forward with minimal supervision. You will operate and evolve our Terraform\-based platform and CI/CD pipelines, serving as a key contributor to our global infrastructure strategy.
   

  

 ShyftLabs is a growing data product company that was founded in early 2020 and works primarily with Fortune 500 companies. We deliver digital solutions built to help accelerate the growth of businesses in various industries, by focusing on creating value through innovation.
   

  

**Cloud Infrastructure \& Ownership**
* Manage and optimize production infrastructure across AWS and GCP (with secondary support for Azure)
* Act as a technical owner for assigned projects, resolving complex infrastructure challenges independently
* Proactively identify performance bottlenecks and reliability risks, implementing solutions before they become incidents
* Take full ownership of tasks from design to deployment


**Infrastructure as Code (IaC) \& Automation**
* Design, write, and maintain high\-quality Terraform code to manage infrastructure
* Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins) to automate deployments and enforce guardrails
* Automate repetitive operational tasks using scripting (Python/Bash) and serverless functions
* Review peer code and enforce best practices for state management and modularization


**Security \& Governance**
* Implement and enforce IAM policies, ensuring least\-privilege access across cloud environments
* Audit cloud resources for security compliance and cost optimization
* Drive security initiatives, such as rotation of credentials and hardening of network perimeters


**Collaboration \& Reliability**
* Drive post\-incident reviews (RCAs) and implement long\-term fixes
* Maintain comprehensive documentation and runbooks
* Work collaboratively with engineering teams to ensure infrastructure meets application requirements


**Requirements**
* AWS
* GCP
* Terraform

* GitLab CI
* GitHub Actions
* Jenkins

* Bash

* Infrastructure as Code
* DevOps

**Preferred Skills**
* Azure

* Proven production experience in AWS and/or GCP (Experience in both is a strong plus; willingness to master both is required)
* Strong hands\-on experience with Terraform (comfortable writing modules, managing state, and handling complex dependencies)
* Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions
* Proficiency in Python or Bash for automation tasks

e23db02a.title: Cloud Platform Architect
e23db02a.description:
The era of pervasive AI has arrived. In this era, organizations will use generative AI to unlock hidden value in their data, accelerate processes, reduce costs, drive efficiency and innovation to fundamentally transform their businesses and operations at scale.
   

  

 SambaNova Suite™ is the first full\-stack, generative AI platform, from chip to model, optimized for enterprise and government organizations. Powered by the intelligent SN40L chip, the SambaNova Suite is a fully integrated platform, delivered on\-premises or in the cloud, combined with state\-of\-the\-art open\-source models that can be easily and securely fine\-tuned using customer data for greater accuracy. Once adapted with customer data, customers retain model ownership in perpetuity, so they can turn generative AI into one of their most valuable assets.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Cloud Platform team owns the production inferencing service that serves SambaNova's models to customers on RDU accelerators, including capacity planning, deployment, monitoring, and incident response across regions in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Cloud Operations team is seeking an experienced engineering leader to scale the platform our internal and external customers use to access SambaNova RDUs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you'll architecting our next\-generation system from the ground up, running the Kubernetes infrastructure that powers some of the most advanced AI workloads in the industry, and bridging multi\-cloud and on\-prem environments in ways no generic SaaS company can offer. Your work will directly impact the productivity of every engineer at SambaNova and by extension, the speed at which we ship the future of AI computing.
   

  

 Some of your responsibilities include:
   

  

* Architect, build, and maintain our next\-generation internal developer platform, automating and streamlining our cloud and on\-prem infrastructure
* Design, write, and manage Terraform modules to provision and manage resources across AWS, GCP, and Azure, ensuring consistency and reproducibility
* Build and manage highly available, secure, and performant Kubernetes clusters that serve as the primary runtime for our diverse AI workloads
* Design and implement robust networking solutions (VPCs, load balancers, firewalls, service meshes) that seamlessly connect our multi\-cloud and hybrid environments
* Collaborate with AI and software engineering teams to understand their needs, provide golden paths to production, and build internal tools that accelerate their development cycles
* Implement best practices for observability (monitoring, logging, tracing) to ensure system reliability and performance, and participate in on\-call rotation


**Required Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure roles
* Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Rust)
* Expertise with Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, or self\-managed) in production environments \- pods, operators, CRDs, CNIs, etc.
* Expertise with Infrastructure as Code with the ability to manage complex, multi\-cloud environments
* Strong proficiency with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), with a solid understanding of the core services (compute, storage, networking, IAM)
* Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, load balancing) and security best practices in the cloud


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a hybrid environment bridging cloud and on\-premise/data center infrastructure
* Experience managing infrastructure for data\-intensive or ML/AI workloads
* Knowledge of building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD)
* Experience with service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd)
* Contributions to open\-source projects or a public portfolio of code (GitHub)


 Base Salary Range:
   

  

 Base Pay Range
   

  

 ₹10,300,000—₹12,800,000 INR
   

  

**Submission Guidelines**
 Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.
   

  

**EEO Policy**
 SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Benefits Summary For US\-Based, Full\-Time Employment Positions**
 SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD\&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well\-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass\+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

a53c32ce.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
a53c32ce.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

9da010e2.title: Qentelli Solutions - Technical Product Manager
9da010e2.description:
**Job Summary**
 We're hiring a Technical Product Manager who can hold the platform's integrations and data flows in their head, turn that into a clear product vision, and take it through to a shipped, adopted result. You'll spend real time in the technical weeds, reading integration docs, reasoning about data models, and prototyping ideas yourself before handing them to engineering. You own the roadmap and you own delivery.
   

  

**Technical Skills We're Looking For**
 This is a product role, not an engineering role. You won't be writing production code day to day, but you need to be comfortable enough with code and systems to prototype, pull data, or debug something yourself when it matters.
   

  

**Our stack :** 
 Node.js, TypeScript, Express, and Drizzle on the backend. React, TypeScript, Zustand, and TanStack on the frontend. Postgres for the database, Redis for caching, and JWT for authentication. Event streaming runs across services, with Azure Blob Storage for files. Our AI layer runs on Python, Streamlit, ChromaDB, and RAG.
   

  

* Can read API docs and data models without engineering translating.
* Comfortable reading and reasoning about a TypeScript codebase, front end and back end.
* SQL literacy, comfortable querying Postgres directly to pull and interpret data.
* Understands authentication (JWT), event\-driven architecture, and third\-party integrations.
* Can write or edit a simple TypeScript or Python script for a prototype or data pull.
* Familiarity with RAG pipelines and vector databases (like ChromaDB) is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on experience with Node.js, React, TypeScript, or Python is a strong plus.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision and roadmap for an AI\-first, agentic operator experience.
* Balance near\-term commitments against longer\-term platform and AI investment.
* Get deep enough into integrations and data flows to make calls without an engineer translating for you.
* Define where AI recommendations or automation remove manual work, and set the guardrails that make it safe.
* Write specs and acceptance criteria engineering can build against the first time, including analytics requirements.
* Run discovery with operators and consumers, and turn findings into prioritized problems.
* Track your initiatives through delivery, flag risk early, and present results to leadership clearly.


**What You Bring**
* 6\-8 years in product management, including 2\+ years owning something with real technical complexity.
* A track record of shipping outcomes you can point to specific metrics for, not just shipping features.
* Experience defining requirements for AI/automation features, including guardrails and failure modes.
* Strong prototyping instincts: comfortable with design tools, no\-code platforms, or AI\-assisted prototyping.
* Sharp communication that flexes between an engineering deep\-dive and a concise executive update.
* Experience designing for time\-constrained, non\-technical, or mobile\-first users.
* A bias toward ownership: you finish what you start and flag problems before they compound.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience in hospitality, travel, marketplace, or commerce platforms.
* Prior experience with loyalty, payments, or booking/reservation systems.
* Experience defining requirements for conversational or voice\-based AI interfaces.

* Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval systems.
