54b5432f.title: Senior Solutions Architect - Generative AI
54b5432f.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect who can operate fluently across two worlds: the AI Factory infrastructure stack\-designing accelerated compute environments built on DGX/HGX, networking, storage, and orchestration \-and the Generative \& Agentic AI application stack \-guiding customers through open\-source frameworks, NeMo, NIM, and Blueprints to deliver production AI workloads.
   

  

 You will be a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers, partnering with sales, product, and engineering to translate business outcomes into deployable architectures.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Lead enterprise customers through the full lifecycle of on\-prem Generative AI — from use case discovery and model selection to fine\-tuning, deployment, and continuous evaluation.
* Architect production\-grade RAG systems using NeMo Retriever, embedding and reranker NIMs, and vector databases such as Milvus, pgvector, and Weaviate, tuned for accuracy, latency, and cost at scale.
* Guide customers in selecting and customizing open\-source foundation models like Llama, Mistral, Qwen, and Gemma, and lead them through fine\-tuning workflows using NeMo Customizer, PEFT/LoRA, SFT, DPO, and RLHF.
* Compose and build agentic applications using frameworks like LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and NVIDIA AI Blueprints, covering use cases such as customer service automation, enterprise search, document intelligence, video analytics, software engineering agents, and industry\-specific copilots.
* Advise on inference optimization with TensorRT\-LLM, vLLM, and SGLang, including quantization, speculative decoding, and multi\-LoRA serving.
* Champion responsible AI practices: guardrails (NeMo Guardrails), red\-teaming, evaluation harnesses, and observability for LLM and agent systems.
* Help customers operationalize GenAI with accurate MLOps — versioning, CI/CD for prompts and models, drift detection, and human\-in\-the\-loop feedback.
* Provide architectural mentorship on on\-prem AI Factory deployments built around DGX BasePOD/SuperPOD, HGX\-based OEM systems, Spectrum\-X and Quantum InfiniBand networking, and high\-performance storage.
* Scale clusters appropriately for combined fine\-tuning and inference tasks. Build orchestration layers through Kubernetes, including the NVIDIA GPU Operator, Network Operator, and Run:ai. Apply Slurm as needed.
* Lead technical workshops, PoCs, and architecture reviews with enterprise customers as well as represent NVIDIA at customer briefings, industry events, and technical forums.
* Translate field findings into product feedback for NVIDIA engineering as well as build reusable assets such as reference architectures, deployment guides, and demos that scale across the SA community.


**What We Need To See**
* 5–8 years of experience as a Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, ML Platform Engineer, or similar customer\-facing technical role.
* Strong hands\-on background with accelerated computing infrastructure: GPUs, high\-speed interconnects (InfiniBand, RoCE), parallel file systems (Lustre, GPFS, WEKA, VAST, or DDN or equivalent experience), and data center fundamentals.
* Production experience with Kubernetes and at least one workload scheduler like Run:ai, Slurm, KubeFlow, or Volcano in GPU\-accelerated environments.
* Practical depth in Generative AI: LLM training/fine\-tuning, RAG architectures, inference optimization (TensorRT\-LLM, vLLM, SGLang), and quantization.
* Experience with the NVIDIA AI Enterprise software stack (NeMo, NIM, Triton, RAPIDS, CUDA\-X) or a strong desire and capability to learn rapidly.
* Experience crafting solutions for enterprise constraints: air\-gapped environments, data sovereignty, security/compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP\-adjacent), and multi\-tenancy.
* Excellent communication skills \- able to present to CTOs and CIOs, then drop into a kubectl session with a platform engineer.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Hands\-on experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex agents) in production settings.
* Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects or published technical content (blogs, talks, papers).
* Experience working with NVIDIA AI Blueprints or developing equivalent enterprise reference solutions.
* Background in a specific vertical \- financial services, healthcare/life sciences, manufacturing, retail, or telco.
* Familiarity with sovereign AI initiatives or large\-scale on\-prem GenAI deployments. Working knowledge of MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, Argo, Kubeflow Pipelines).


 Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

93711001.title: Architect - SAP S4 Migration - Asset & PS Specialist
93711001.description:
**Overview**
 The SAP S4 Migration is a comprehensive, multi\-year program spanning over four years, aimed at modernizing the current SAP PIRT landscape. This initiative covers various regions including MENA, LATAM, PGCS, APAC, and Europe. The goal of this program is to prepare the SAP system for the future, aligning it with PepsiCo's digital transformation journey.
   

  

 The project involves planning, executing, and overseeing the successful migration of data and business processes from existing SAP ECC systems to S/4HANA. This will include designing remediation of deprecated functionalities, designing new functionalities for obsolete functionalities, executing data migration objects, and ensuring data quality and integrity throughout the process. This will also be working in close collaboration with technical and business stakeholders to align goals and expectations.
   

  

 The project aims to replace legacy systems by implementing the SAP S/4 HANA business suite. This suite will cover various functions including Record to Report (RTR), Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), Order to Cash (OTC), Purchase to Pay (PTP), Make to Deploy (MTD), Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Warehouse Management (WM) and Trade Promotional Management (TPM).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Ensure Seamless Migration: Ensure that SAP ECC processes are remediated and migrated to SAP S/4 RTR out any design gaps focussing on G/L, Banking, Assets, Project Systems etc.
* Design and Build: Create design documentation where existing functionalities have become obsolete. Remediate object which are identified by for remediation.
* System Readiness: Prepare the current SAP system for migration by applying necessary updates and configurations, such as SAP notes and pre\-migration checks.
* Data Migration: Oversee the technical migration of data from legacy systems to the SAP S/4HANA environment. Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance throughout the migration process by conducting data validation and reconciliation
* Data Validation: ensuring data integrity and minimal disruption to business operations.
* Comprehensive Testing: Conduct thorough testing to validate the functionality and performance of the new system, ensuring it meets all business requirements and standards.
* Change Management: Support the Change management in identifies processes and/or transactions which will get impacted.
* Training and Support: Provide training and support to super users for the changes to ensure a smooth transition and effective use of the new system.
* Issue Resolution: Identify and resolve data migration issues promptly, collaborating with data migration and tech team as needed. Track issues throughout the migration life cycle and ensure issue resolution in timely manner for the overall project success
* Promote Collaboration: Foster an environment where communication, teamwork, and innovation are encouraged.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure adherence to the internal IT operating model, including technology standards, project life cycle methodology, release management, change management, and other related processes and procedures, SLAs, and controls compliance. Accountable for ensuring proper governance is followed for all RTR areas
* Project Communication: Own project status and communication for all related work in the project. Accountable for ensuring project status reporting is done weekly and senior executive\-level communications are timely and accurate.
* Reuse Asset: Create reuse asset which can be leveraged during migration to optimize the efforts for sectors planned later in the migration journey.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum bachelor’s degree is required. Computer Science or Information Systems is preferred.
* 9 \- 13 years of experience configuring, deploying and managing SAP ERP with a focus on SAP RTR – General Ledger, Banking, Assets, Project System
* Experienced in 2\-3 Implementation Project in SAP S4 for RTR
* Process knowledge and SAP solution mapping experience for General Ledger \& Banking, Assets, Interfaces to applications like Blackline, Celonis, HFM, Skelta etc.
* Exposure to SAP Profitability Analysis and Product Costing preferred
* Integration across other functional areas, i.e., Procure to pay, Make to Deploy \& Order to Cash
* Prior experience on S4 Migration or experience data validation strategy would be preferred.
* Prior experience in working on solutions for managing ACDOCA growth preferred
* Deep understanding of project test phases and testing automation tools.
* Fully aware of the SAP security design implications through global roles. Familiar to the GRC best practices in large corporations as PepsiCo
* Dispatches standard SAP quality issues with OSS (Online SAP Services) and follows up the required break fixes
* Demonstrated Leadership skills, including planning, organization, prioritization, collaboration
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization
* Ability to work flexible hours based on varying business requirements
* Solves complex problems within their work team
* Strong influencing, facilitating, and consulting skills in working with stakeholders at all levels in the organization and across departments
* Ability to clear obstacles for teams to deliver
* Experience with LATAM, Europe, MENA and APAC preferred

0afa5921.title: Global Technology Solution Owner – Consolidation & Reporting
0afa5921.description:

 The Global Technology Solution Owner \- Consolidation \& Reporting acts as the primary Business Partner for Finance functions in Consolidation, Product Margin Calculation, Reporting, and Analytics. In this role, you will serve as the IT functional lead, collaborating closely with Business Teams, Technology Teams, and Business Process Owners (BPO) to drive functional and process\-related discussions.
   

  

 You will hold active governance and technical ownership of solutions in the Consolidation \& Reporting area (e.g., SAP Finance Reporting \& Analytics Core governance), working alongside Business and Technical Delivery Teams to shape, prioritize, and realize technology evolution. Developing and defining the technology direction, strategy, and roadmap for Finance Consolidation and Product Margin solutions aligned with the overall SAP Finance Reporting \& Analytics strategy and in cooperation with relevant Platform and Architecture Teams\-is a key component of this role.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Define, align (with Business leads and within Technology teams) and support building technology delivery strategy for Finance consolidation, product margin calculation, reporting and analytics solutions with an aim of bringing cutting\-edge innovation, process standardization with high focus on user experience, automation and efficiency improvements.

* Continuously improve the solutions to meet the ongoing business requirements and optimize the costs to have an improved TCO

* Run the established governance structure for projects with right stakeholder representation in area of responsibility. Support overall establishment of corresponding governance structures in SAP Finance \& Analytics team

* Provide transparent and accurate project/program/portfolio management and reporting. Own program/project status, issues and risks in area of responsibility. Manage risks and issues through appropriate channels / tools with focus on setting and tracking actions, ownership, and comprehensive risk management.
* Collaborate and Ensure operational services / enhancements are effectively delivered in the area of responsibility
* Collaborate effectively with other teams, Technology Functions and Domains in the organization, as well as strategic suppliers providing services.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* 10\+ years of experience in program/project delivery and application portfolio management within SAP BI space (e.g. BW/BI/BPC, SAC, BDC, BW/4HANA) with special focus on Finance, in multinational organizations.
* Strong technical skills in SAP BW/BI/BPC, SAC and ideally in BDC, BW/4HANA, Datasphere, Databricks

**Qualifications**

* Certification in SAP BI and analytics area (e.g. SAC, BDC, BW/4HANA, BI/BPC, etc.) or proven/documented expertise in SAP BI/Analytics area
* Education/certification/proven expertise in Financial and Management accounting and/or Financial Consolidation beneficial
* Experience with Agile/DevOps methodologies; Certification is a plus.

 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!

**Join us!**

2da73af9.title: Solutions Architecture Manager 1
2da73af9.description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Solutions Architecture Manager is a highly proficient, hands\-on solution architect for RSM custom solutions. This role owns end\-to\-end microservice and API architecture for assigned solutions, defines Domain\-Driven Design boundaries and event\-driven patterns on Azure Service Bus, and sets engineering standards across React frontend and .NET/Python backend teams. The role operates with growing autonomy across the custom solutions estate and represents designs in architecture reviews.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business and product requirements into end\-to\-end solution designs for RSM custom solutions spanning multiple frontend and backend services.
* Adapt quickly to evolving engineering priorities, market trends, and emerging technologies; rapidly evaluate new technology areas and produce proof\-of\-concepts, technical assessments, and analysis reports to support timely decision\-making and delivery expectations.
* Design microservice and API architectures for custom\-built solutions; define service boundaries using Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) principles.
* Architect event\-driven integration patterns using Azure Service Bus; define message schemas, topic/subscription models, and error\-handling strategies.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices across frontend (React) and backend (.NET / Python) teams.
* Ensure non\-functional requirements (security, scalability, resiliency, observability) are embedded into all solution designs.
* Lead architecture and design reviews for new features, technical initiatives, and third\-party integrations within assigned solutions.
* Produce and maintain architecture decision records (ADRs), high\-level design (HLD) documents, and API specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger).
* Collaborating with product managers, UX designers, and engineering leads to shape technical roadmaps.
* Provide technical mentorship to senior engineers and conduct design and code reviews.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of software engineering or architecture experience, with at least 5 years in a solution architect role on complex, multi\-service platforms.
* Expert\-level proficiency in designing microservices architectures and RESTful / GraphQL APIs.
* Deep hands\-on experience with React (frontend architecture) and .NET and/or Python (backend services).
* Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL database platforms, including data modeling, partitioning, indexing, performance optimization, and selection of appropriate persistence patterns for distributed, cloud\-native applications.
* Working knowledge of observability and operational excellence, including monitoring strategies, distributed tracing, telemetry standards, and production diagnostics using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry.
* Strong experience with Azure cloud services, including Azure Service Bus, Azure API Management, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure DevOps.
* Advanced understanding of Domain\-Driven Design, CQRS, Event Sourcing, and distributed systems patterns.
* Hands\-on knowledge and experience in designing and implementing AI\-enabled solutions using AI agent frameworks, Azure AI services such as Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search, and LLMs/SLMs.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevSecOps practices.
* Working knowledge of OpenID Connect / OAuth 2\.0 and fine\-grained authorization in multi\-tenant SaaS environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including API\-led connectivity, event\-driven messaging, asynchronous communication patterns, data synchronization, system interoperability, and integration platform technologies used to connect cloud, SaaS, and custom applications.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; experience presenting designs to senior technology stakeholders.
* Professional services or B2B SaaS product experience is advantageous.
* Experience with BPM and integration platforms (e.g., Camunda, Boomi, MuleSoft) is highly desirable.
* Experience architecting Agentic AI solutions is preferred.


**Core Skills \& Technologies**
* Microservices Architecture
* API Design
* Azure Service Bus
* React
* .NET
* Python
* Domain\-Driven Design
* Event\-Driven Architecture
* Azure Cloud
* CI/CD \& DevSecOps
* NFRs
* Architecture Review

50bc5412.title: Principal AI Solution Engineer
50bc5412.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
 Join Novonesis as a Principal AI Solution Engineer and play a leading role in scaling AI solutions across our global organisation. You will drive enterprise\-wide enablement, support the development of AI use cases, and help translate business opportunities into solutions. You will provide strategic guidance and help build the capabilities needed to accelerate AI adoption at scale in a highly adaptive, and cross\-functional environment. \*
   

  

 \*\*Welcome to the Data \& AI Enablement team. \*\*
   

  

 The Data \& AI Enablement team is part of the Data Office within Global IT, serving as a Centre of Excellence for enterprise\-wide data and AI adoption. You will join a highly collaborative team of specialists in Denmark and India, working closely with business stakeholders in an agile and supportive environment. Together, we help citizen developers and business teams create value from platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Copilot, and Copilot Studio through enablement, governance, and community building. The role offers broad exposure across Novonesis, connecting you with stakeholders and initiatives spanning the entire value chain.
   

  

 \*\*In this role you will make an impact…\*\*
   

  

 Your work will focus on innovation and enablement at scale, balancing strategic platform governance with hands\-on solutioning. You will help mature our enablement model for Copilot Studio, establish best practices for citizen developers, and guide business teams from ideation to implementation. Through our AI Centre of Excellence approach, you will support complex use cases and act as a senior advisor, identifying AI use cases and opportunities for AI to transform business processes.
   

  

 In addition, some of your key tasks will include:
   

  

* Owning the Copilot Studio enablement track globally, including training, governance, and support.
* Establishing best practices for citizen developers working with Copilot Studio.
* Driving enterprise adoption of Copilot\-based solutions by engaging with business teams and shaping high\-value use cases.
* Building and scaling the citizen developer ecosystem through training programmes, learning journeys, and community activities.
* Ensuring governance, security, and platform and use case alignment by collaborating with IT Security, Legal, and platform teams.


 Collaboration will be central to your role, as you work daily with colleagues in India and Denmark, engaging with stakeholders across business\- and platform teams to deliver impactful AI solutions.
   

  

 \*\*We expect you to bring…\*\*
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in AI, automation, or digital enablement roles
* Strong experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, or similar citizen developer platform
* Proven track record of driving adoption of new technologies in large organisations
* Proven track record for project management
* Experience working with generative AI or conversational agents
* Experience with governance frameworks within enterprise environments


 Additionally, we expect you to demonstrate familiarity with Microsoft Ecosystem including Copilot/Cowork, analytics platforms such as Power BI and Fabric, and a background in consulting or internal advisory roles. Your ability to support complex solution design and align technical solutions with business requirements will be highly valued.
   

  

 You will excel in this role if you have strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills, enjoy structured and scalable thinking, and are comfortable navigating an evolving space. An interest in AI adoption and its organisational impact, as well as the ability to bridge business needs and technical solutions, will help you succeed.
   

  

**Our purpose guides the way**
 In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**Opportunities for everyone**
 We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
   

  

 We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
   

  

**Explore Other Openings**
 If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

cdfdbe44.description:
**Job Description**
 Cloud / DevOps Engineer would lead the implementation, automation, and operational reliability of cloud\-native and DevOps solutions across Azure environments, with awareness of equivalent AWS patterns where required. The role would involve transformation of MVP applications into production\-grade, multi\-tenant SaaS platforms by enabling cloud\-native deployment architecture—driving database migration support, containerized deployments on Azure, secure identity and access management, CI/CD pipeline implementation, observability setup, environment consistency, and performance optimization for scalable operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Cloud Architecture \& Implementation**
* Design and implement scalable, secure, and cost\-optimized cloud solutions primarily on Azure.
* Drive adoption of PaaS, managed services, and container\-based deployment models.
* Enable deployment architecture using Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Blob Storage, Key Vault, and Entra ID / AAD.
* Establish cloud governance, environment consistency, access control, and cost optimization practices.


**Containerization \& Platform Engineering**
* Design and implement container\-based application deployment using Docker.
* Build and optimize Docker Compose setups for multi\-service environments and multi\-stage builds for secure, lightweight images.
* Support deployment using orchestration services such as Kubernetes (AKS / EKS awareness) or Azure Container Apps.
* Improve platform consistency, portability, and deployment repeatability.


**CI/CD \& DevOps Transformation**
* Architect and implement end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps.
* Enable automated builds, testing, and deployment with multi\-stage environment promotion.
* Support deployment strategies such as blue\-green, canary, or rolling updates.
* Improve release reliability, deployment speed, and operational maturity.


**Reliability, Observability \& Operations**
* Implement observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, and APM tooling.
* Enable health checks, readiness validation, alerting, incident response readiness, and SLO\-based monitoring.
* Support resilience mechanisms including retries, graceful degradation, and fault\-aware deployment patterns.


**Security \& DevSecOps**
* Implement secure DevOps practices including secret management, identity and role\-based access controls, and pipeline\-integrated security scans.
* Ensure secure configuration and alignment with enterprise standards for cloud delivery and operations.


**Performance \& Scalability**
* Support performance strategies including caching, autoscaling, deployment tuning, and environment optimization.
* Assist with provisioning and managing Redis / distributed cache services where applicable.
* Enable scalable deployment patterns for growing user demand and system load.
* Required Technical Skills
* Docker / Containers \| Advanced — Compose, multi\-stage builds, image hardening, container deployment
* Azure Cloud \| Proficient — App Service, Functions, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Entra ID / AAD
* CI/CD \| Advanced — GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps; automated testing and staged deployments
* Git \| Advanced — branching strategies, PR workflows, repository governance
* Cluster Provisioning \& Management \| Proficient — Kubernetes / AKS / container orchestration awareness
* Monitoring \& Operations \| Proficient — Azure Monitor, App Insights, dashboards, alerts, logs
* Security \& Automation \| Proficient — secrets, identity, access control, scanning, IaC awareness


**Required Experience**
* Minimum 6 years of professional experience in Cloud / DevOps engineering.
* Proven experience in enabling cloud\-native deployment practices for enterprise or SaaS applications.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and environment promotion strategies.
* Experience supporting containerized deployments and modern cloud\-hosted applications.
* Experience with observability, operational monitoring, and incident\-supporting platform practices.
* Exposure to secure DevOps practices, secrets management, and identity\-based access controls.
* Experience improving deployment reliability, automation, and operational consistency across environments.


**Preferred (Not Required)**
* Exposure to MVP\-to\-production modernization programs.
* Experience with Terraform / Bicep / infrastructure\-as\-code tooling.
* Exposure to SaaS multi\-tenancy, API gateways, or cloud platform hardening.
* Experience in consultancy, infrastructure, or engineering sector platforms.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted engineering productivity tooling.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or platform operations.

6719e9c1.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
   

  

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Lead Architect \- Azure \& Agentic AI Solutions**
*Architecture leadership for Azure deployment, agent design, orchestration and end\-to\-end solution flow*
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Lead Architect to define the target architecture for an enterprise\-grade procurement agentic AI solution. The role will determine the appropriate Azure deployment stack, establish architecture principles and guardrails, and advise on agent architecture, orchestration patterns, integration design, and end\-to\-end solution flows. The Lead Architect will work closely with client technology stakeholders, the Solution Lead, AI/ML teams, data engineers, security teams and delivery leadership to ensure the solution is scalable, secure, operable and fit for enterprise deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end target architecture across data, AI/ML, GenAI, agent orchestration, APIs, integration, observability, security and user\-facing application layers.
* Assess client constraints and determine the appropriate Azure deployment stack, including services for compute, storage, data processing, model serving, GenAI, integration, secrets, networking, monitoring and CI/CD.
* Define cloud deployment patterns across Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks or equivalent data platforms, AKS, Container Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus or Event Grid, Key Vault, Monitor and related services as appropriate.
* Advise on when to use agents, conventional services, rules engines, workflow orchestration, ML models, optimization services and event\-driven automation rather than forcing all use cases into an agent pattern.
* Translate business workflows into executable solution flows spanning sensing, signal processing, forecasting, recommendation, approval, action and traceability layers.
* Define API and integration architecture for interaction with enterprise source systems, planning tools, data platforms, UI applications, model endpoints and external services.
* Establish non\-functional requirements and architecture guardrails for scalability, latency, resilience, disaster recovery, cost efficiency, explainability, auditability and supportability.
* Define identity and access patterns, network segmentation, secrets management, data protection controls, content safety, prompt security and responsible AI controls in collaboration with client security teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, technical decision records and trade\-off discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Provide hands\-on guidance to engineering teams on implementation patterns, reusable components, deployment standards and technical issue resolution.
* Own architecture alignment across environments including development, test, UAT, and production, with clear promotion, rollback and release patterns.
* Guide observability design across application traces, agent traces, prompt and tool execution, model performance, API metrics, data pipeline health, cost usage and business process outcomes.
* Support capacity planning and cloud cost optimization, including workload sizing, token consumption controls, autoscaling, caching, batching and appropriate service selection.
* Collaborate with the Lead Manager and Solution Lead to balance delivery timelines with architecture quality and enterprise readiness.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise solution architecture, cloud architecture, platform engineering or related technology leadership roles.
* Strong hands\-on architecture experience with Microsoft Azure and enterprise deployment patterns.
* Proven experience designing distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, containerized workloads and cloud\-native integrations.
* Strong understanding of GenAI and agentic AI architecture, including LLM orchestration, tool calling, RAG, state and memory patterns, evaluation, guardrails and human approval mechanisms.
* Ability to design architectures that combine conventional software services, AI/ML models, optimization engines, data pipelines and agentic workflows.
* Strong knowledge of security, identity, networking, observability, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code and production operations in enterprise environments.
* Experience engaging with client architects, CIO/CTO organizations, cloud platform teams, security stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Strong ability to communicate architecture trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders and drive decisions under real\-world constraints.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, AKS, Container Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Key Vault, Entra ID and Azure Monitor.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent patterns and frameworks.
* Exposure to supply chain, demand forecasting, planning, semiconductor or high\-tech industry solutions.
* Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, prompt and agent evaluation and production AI governance.
* Relevant Azure architecture certifications or equivalent demonstrable experience.


**Key Deliverables**
* Target\-state solution architecture and Azure service deployment blueprint.
* Agent architecture and orchestration design, including tool boundaries and control flows.
* End\-to\-end sequence flows for key business scenarios and exception paths.
* Integration, API, identity, networking, security, observability and environment architecture.
* Architecture decision records, non\-functional requirements, deployment standards and engineering guardrails.
* Production\-readiness and scalability recommendations, including cost and operational considerations.


**Key Success Metrics**
* Architecture is accepted by client technology and security stakeholders with minimal late\-stage redesign.
* Solution is deployable, scalable, secure, observable and supportable across enterprise environments.
* Agent and orchestration patterns remain controlled, explainable and appropriate to the business workflow.
* Reduction in integration rework, deployment friction, technical debt and avoidable cloud cost.
* Engineering teams can implement consistently using clear architecture standards and reusable patterns.

b5d22ae1.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
   

  

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Lead Architect – Full\-Stack, Cloud, Data \& AI Engineering**
*Technical leadership of the end\-to\-end build, with accountability for establishing the team's deployment capability and mentoring Forward Deployed Engineers to independence*
**Role Overview**
 The Lead Architect sets and owns the technical direction for enterprise agentic AI solutions across application, cloud, data and AI layers — and delivers it through the team rather than personally. The primary mandate is to raise engineering capability: establish standards and reusable deployment assets, guide design and review work, and mentor Forward Deployed Engineers until they can build, deploy and operate solutions in client environments without escalation. Hands\-on work is expected selectively — to stay technically credible and unblock the team — not as sustained feature delivery.
   

  

**Capability Coverage**
**Full\-stack engineering**
**What the role is accountable for \-** 
 Standards and patterns for Python services, JavaScript/TypeScript front ends, SQL and NoSQL data design, APIs, CI/CD and DevOps
   

  

**Mode of working \-** 
 Guide, review, spike
   

  

**Azure cloud architecture**
**What the role is accountable for \-** 
 Target\-state architecture, service selection, identity, networking, environments, non\-functional targets and cloud cost discipline
   

  

**Mode of working \-** 
 Own and decide
   

  

**Data engineering**
**What the role is accountable for \-** 
 PySpark and Databricks pipeline architecture, layered data design, quality controls and performance standards
   

  

**Mode of working \-** 
 Direct and review
   

  

**AI engineering \& AIOps**
**What the role is accountable for \-** 
 Agent and orchestration design, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, human\-approval flows, tracing, versioning and drift monitoring
   

  

**Mode of working \-** 
 Own and direct
   

  

**Leadership Responsibilities**
* Technical direction: Own the target architecture and the agentic\-versus\-deterministic decisions; hold the line on where agents add value and where rules or workflows suffice.
* Lead through the team: Break scope into buildable increments, run design walkthroughs and code reviews, and set the coding, testing, release and documentation standards the team works to.
* Build deployment capability: Convert today's person\-dependent deployment into documented, reusable practice — reference architecture, IaC modules, pipeline templates, runbooks and environment checklists.
* Mentor FDEs to independence: Pair on builds, review their designs, run structured enablement, and hand over deployment ownership against defined competency milestones.
* Stakeholder ownership: Carry architecture and security posture through client technology and security review; act as final technical escalation on deployment and production issues.
* Selective hands\-on: Prototype high\-risk components, resolve critical\-path blockers, and review production code — sufficient depth to make credible decisions, without becoming the delivery bottleneck.


**Required Experience**
* 10\+ years in software, platform or applied AI engineering, including 4\+ years leading engineering teams on systems that reached production.
* Full\-stack delivery background — Python, relational and NoSQL stores, web application deployment, CI/CD and DevOps practice.
* Hands\-on architecture experience with the standing to own and defend decisions with client cloud and security teams.
* Working depth in PySpark and Databricks, and in agent development with a mainstream orchestration framework plus evaluation and production monitoring.
* Demonstrated record of mentoring engineers and raising team capability — not only shipping personally.


**Success Measures**
* Named FDEs deploy and operate solutions independently; delivery is not dependent on this individual.

* Solutions reach production on committed timelines, with architecture and security accepted with minimal remediation.

* Configure and document security policies, access management protocols, and vulnerability management processes to ensure compliance and governance standards are met.

**Senior Cloud Developer, Bangalore**

* Manage Containerization: Architect, scale, and optimize production\-ready Kubernetes (EKS) clusters.

We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in Dubai, UK, USA and France.
   

  

* Designation: Pre\-Sales Consultant
* Relevant Experience: 2 \- 4 Years
* Qualification: MBA (Finance/Banking), CA, CFA, FRM, B.Com, M.Com, BBM, BE/B.Tech or equivalent qualification


**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As a Pre\-Sales Consultant, you will support business development and sales engagements by understanding client requirements, positioning Surya’s solutions, and demonstrating the value of our products to banks, financial institutions, and corporate customers. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams across the complete sales lifecycle.
   

  

* Attend client requirement discussions and understand business, functional, and solution needs.
* Conduct product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, workshops, and presentations for prospective customers.
* Prepare and submit responses for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and other proposal\-related documentation.
* Prepare solution decks, product write\-ups, proposal content, business presentations, and customer\-facing collateral.
* Provide content support for certifications, ratings, analyst questionnaires, industry assessments, and related submissions.
* Work collaboratively with Field Sales, Sales Operations, Inside Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to support sales opportunities.
* Assist in solution positioning, proposal preparation, proof\-of\-concept discussions, and customer clarifications.
* Stay updated on banking, financial risk management, regulatory developments, and competitive product offerings.

* Ability to prepare customer\-facing solution proposals, presentations, and business write\-ups.


*Technical*
* Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word – Mandatory.
* Ability to create clear solution decks, product collateral, and proposal documents.
* SQL basics and understanding of databases – Good to have.
* Understanding of enterprise software products and implementation lifecycle is an added advantage.


**Other Essential Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation, listening, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively across multiple teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.

* Prior experience in software product pre\-sales, solution consulting, business consulting, or client\-facing product demonstrations.
* Prior exposure to Financial Risk Management products or banking product pre\-sales will be an added advantage.

b6cecb92.title: Algoworks - Atlassian Solution Architect
b6cecb92.description:
**About The Company**
 Algoworks is an award\-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and India.
   

  

 We bring together a global team of engineers, architects, designers, researchers and operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable results.
   

  

 For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful business outcomes.
   

  

 Our work combines human\-centered design, engineering excellence and AI\-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision.
   

  

 Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams approach problem\-solving and continuous improvement.
   

  

 At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact.
   

  

 Teams collaborate across geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and collective expertise.
   

  

 The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.
   

  

 Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Algoworks is seeking a world\-class, experienced and highly hands\-on Atlassian Solution Architect to lead the architecture, governance, optimization and evolution of our Atlassian ecosystem, including Jira, Jira Service Management, Tempo and related capabilities.
   

  

 This role is responsible for ensuring the Atlassian platform operates as a scalable enterprise system rather than a collection of individual projects, workflows and configurations.
   

  

 The architect will combine deep Atlassian expertise with strong systems thinking and business understanding to design simple, secure, maintainable solutions that improve delivery, governance, productivity and data quality.
   

  

 The successful candidate must be proactive and naturally curious about platform health.
   

  

 This person should continuously inspect the environment, identify control gaps, configuration sprawl, technical debt, security risks, inefficient workflows and data\-quality issues and independently drive scalable remediation rather than waiting for problems to be assigned.
   

  

 The architect will set the technical direction, platform standards and solution patterns within which administrators and business teams operate, while remaining hands\-on enough to prototype, troubleshoot and validate complex solutions personally.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Atlassian architecture and strategy :
* Define and continuously evolve the enterprise architecture and roadmap for Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Tempo and related Atlassian capabilities.
* Design scalable standards for projects, workflows, issue types, schemes, fields, screens, permissions, roles, automation, applications and integrations.
* Establish reusable configuration patterns that reduce unnecessary customization, simplify administration and prevent technical debt.
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, scalability, security, maintainability and cost.
* Platform governance, health and continuous optimization :
* Continuously assess the Atlassian environment for architectural weaknesses, configuration sprawl, redundant fields and workflows, excessive permissions, control gaps and performance risks.
* Identify root causes behind recurring platform issues and replace workarounds or manual fixes with sustainable system\-level solutions.
* Establish governance for access, configuration changes, applications, automation and platform standards, with appropriate testing, deployment and rollback controls.
* Maintain clear architecture documentation, configuration standards and technical decision records so the platform remains governable as the organization scales.
* Business process and solution design :
* Partner with Delivery, PMO, Finance, HR, Sales, IT and leadership to understand business processes and translate them into effective Atlassian solutions.
* Analyze the underlying business problem before recommending configuration, automation, customization or integration and challenge approaches that create unnecessary complexity.
* Design solutions that balance user experience, governance, reporting, automation and long\-term maintainability.
* Measure the effectiveness of major platform changes through clear improvements in productivity, control, data quality, visibility or business outcomes.
* Automation, AI and extensibility :
* Proactively identify repetitive, manual or error\-prone processes that can be automated within or around the Atlassian ecosystem.
* Design scalable Jira and Tempo automation with appropriate validation, exception handling, monitoring and awareness of platform limits.
* Use APIs, scripting, cloud services or custom extensions when native capabilities are insufficient, while avoiding unnecessary custom development.
* Evaluate and implement AI\-enabled capabilities that improve project management, reporting, support, knowledge management and administrative productivity.
* Enterprise integration, data and reporting :
* Architect reliable integrations between Atlassian and enterprise platforms such as CRM, ERP, HCM, identity, Microsoft/Azure and business intelligence systems.
* Define system\-of\-record responsibilities, data models, mappings, APIs, authentication, synchronization rules, reconciliation and error\-handling controls.
* Ensure Jira and Tempo are structured to produce accurate, consistent and decision\-ready data without excessive manual transformation.
* Partner with analytics teams to enable automated operational and executive reporting and resolve data\-quality issues at their source.
* Technical leadership and platform enablement :
* Provide architectural direction and technical guidance to Jira Administrators and other teams working within the Atlassian ecosystem.
* Review significant changes for architectural impact, scalability, security and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Lead solution design, technical assessments, proofs of concept and major platform enhancements from concept through implementation.
* Develop team capability so recurring administration can be executed independently within clear architectural and governance standards.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience across Atlassian platforms, enterprise applications or solution architecture, with significant hands\-on Jira experience.
* Deep expertise in Jira Cloud, Jira Service Management, Confluence and the broader Atlassian ecosystem.
* Strong experience with Tempo and enterprise time, resource, capacity or delivery\-management use cases.
* Expert understanding of Jira workflows, schemes, issue types, custom fields, screens, roles, permissions, automation and application architecture.
* Proven experience designing and simplifying enterprise\-scale Atlassian environments.
* Strong experience with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, scripting and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Atlassian with CRM, ERP, HCM, identity, cloud and analytics platforms.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security, access governance, SSO, user provisioning and auditability.
* Proven ability to proactively identify architectural weaknesses and independently design scalable remediation.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across systems, data, integrations and business processes.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into simple, maintainable technical solutions and communicate clearly with engineers and senior business stakeholders.


**Must Have Skills**
* Jira Cloud, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Tempo \- enterprise architecture and administration.
* Strong expertise in Jira workflows, schemes, permissions, custom fields, automation and governance.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, scripting and enterprise integrations.
* Strong Atlassian solution architecture, security, scalability and technical\-debt management experience.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Experience with Atlassian integrations with Azure, CRM, ERP, HCM and BI platforms.
* Knowledge of SSO, identity management, access governance and audit controls.
* Experience with AI\-enabled automation and Atlassian extensibility.


**Desired Attributes**
* Deeply curious about how systems work, where they fail and how they can be improved.
* Proactively identifies problems instead of waiting for tickets, incidents or instructions.
* Thinks in enterprise architecture rather than isolated Jira configurations.
* Strong instinct for simplifying complexity and eliminating technical debt.
* Hands\-on enough to prototype, troubleshoot and validate solutions personally.
* Comfortable challenging existing approaches and proposing better alternatives.
* Makes decisions based on scalability, maintainability, security and measurable business value.
* Rigorous, analytical and detail\-oriented with strong follow\-through.
* AI\-savvy and continuously explores better ways to automate work.
* Strong communicator and collaborative partner across technical and business teams.
* Fun, engaging personality and a team player.


**Interview Process**
* 2 rounds of discussion

c442d174.title: Enterprise Architect & Solutions Architect ( Immediate Joiner)
c442d174.description:
**Location: Delhi**
 We are looking for experienced architectural leaders to join our technology team. These roles will drive strategic alignment, solution governance, and end\-to\-end design across business, application, data, integration, and infrastructure domains.
   

  

**Role 1: Enterprise Architect**
****Job Overview****
 The Enterprise Architect acts as a strategic lead integrated with the Center of Excellence (C4E). You will oversee B2B product, channel, and service strategies to ensure alignment with overarching enterprise architecture standards and target states.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Align B2B product, channel, and service strategies across business, data, application, integration, and infrastructure domains.
* Conduct design reviews, establish guardrails, and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and blueprints.
* Rationalize cross\-program dependencies, mitigate design risks, and actively reduce architectural debt.
* Maintain capability models, maps, and value streams to connect customer experience with enabling platforms.
* Deliver decision\-oriented architecture narratives and trade\-off analyses to senior leadership.
* Guide Solution Architects and project teams on implementing architecture principles and reference patterns.


**Key Deliverables**
* Comprehensive B2B target\-state architecture blueprints.
* Documented architecture principles, reference patterns, and domain\-specific roadmaps.
* Solution architecture review reports, risk assessments, and maintained ADRs.
* High\-Level Design (HLD) aligning operating models with security, delivery, and application standards.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* CX \& Business Alignment: Direct alignment of strategic initiatives to target architecture and measurable improvement in CX metrics.
* Architecture Effectiveness: Reduction of duplicated capabilities/platforms and strict adherence to principles.
* Delivery Enablement: Reduction in design churn/rework and optimized time\-to\-architecture decisions.
* Portfolio Health \& Adoption: Measurable reduction of technical debt and high stakeholder satisfaction/pattern reuse rates.


**Role 2: Solutions Architect**
****Job Overview****
 The Solutions Architect leads technical design and execution for assigned operating model groups. You will translate business requirements into end\-to\-end Solution Plans, collaborate with delivery teams, and ensure adherence to enterprise guardrails.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Develop high\-level solution blueprints and comprehensive Solution Plans covering application, integration, data architecture, and platform impact assessments.
* Perform technical assessments to estimate effort, resources, timelines, and costs.
* Co\-design with cross\-functional teams to align UI/UX and functional capabilities with user needs.
* Collaborate with Technical Program Managers and leads on project schedules, risk mitigation, and technical walkthroughs.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor development teams, and serve as an escalation point for complex design challenges.
* Define integration architecture diagrams, interface contracts, and continuous improvement opportunities.


**Key Deliverables**
* End\-to\-end Solution Plans and designs aligned with ePMO processes and architecture blueprints.
* Technical assessment reports detailing resource requirements, effort estimates, and costs.
* Integration Architecture Diagrams and Interface Contracts for inter\-system interactions.
* Detailed Deployment, Migration, and Technical Risk Mitigation plans.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Quality \& Completeness: On\-time delivery of comprehensive solution designs with zero gaps against business requirements.
* Compliance: Full adherence to client architecture, design principles, security, and delivery standards.
* Risk \& Delivery Management: Timely completion of reviews and proactive identification of risks, dependencies, and testing strategies.


**Note: Only candidates who are willing to work in Delhi and have relevant telecom industry experience will be highly preferred.**

e819d6f6.title: Principal, Cloud Engineer
e819d6f6.description:
**Join the Team Modernizing Medicine**
 At
 **ModMed** 
 , we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach:
 **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** 
 This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.
   

  

**A Culture of Excellence**
 When You Join ModMed, You’re Joining An Award\-winning Team Recognized For Innovation And Employee Satisfaction. From Our Global Headquarters In Boca Raton Florida, And Extensive Employee Base In Hyderabad India, We Are a Team Of 4,500\+ Passionate Problem\-solvers On a Mission To Increase Medical Practice Success And Improve Patient Outcomes
   

  

* Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work
* 2025 Globee Business Awards: Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* 2025 Black Book Awards: Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* Florida Venture Forum: Venture\-Backed Company of the Year


 We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.
   

  

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**
**Job Description Summary**
**Our Mission \& Vision**
* Our Mission: To place doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty\-specific cloud platform.
* Our Vision: A world where the software ModMed builds increases medical\-practice success and improves patient outcomes.
* Our Core Values: Create customer delight \| Save time \| Innovate boldly, then make things happen \| Align passion with purpose \| Think big \| Have fun \| Do good.


**The Role:** 
 Technical Visionary for Reliability and Developer Velocity As a Principal Site Reliability Engineer at ModMed, you are a primary architect of our technical future. You don't just solve problems; you anticipate the needs of a global healthcare platform years in advance. You will think big to define the standards for reliability, scalability, developer velocity, and security that allow our doctors to provide world\-class care without interruption. This is a high\-impact technical leadership role where you will innovate boldly, then make things happen, acting as a vital bridge between engineering, product, and business goals. By aligning passion with purpose, you will build a resilient infrastructure that serves as the backbone for modern medicine and consistently creates customer delight.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 Core Infrastructure Strategy \& Architecture
   

  

* Architectural Strategy \& Technical Governance: Define and execute the long\-term architectural vision for our global AWS cloud ecosystem. Design high\-performance, fault\-tolerant, and cost\-optimized multi\-region topologies capable of scaling elastically to meet massive transaction volumes while enforcing rigorous cloud hygiene (Save time).
* Systemic Observability Ecosystems: Institutionalize "Observability as a Culture" across the enterprise. Architect unified, global telemetry standards using Datadog and OpenTelemetry, transforming raw logs, metrics, and distributed traces into actionable, predictive insights that elevate system reliability across all product engineering groups.
* Developer Platform Evolution \& CI/CD Engineering: Revolutionize the corporate CI/CD philosophy and internal developer platform (IDP) strategy. Engineer systemic, highly automated pipeline improvements using tools like GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, ACK, CUE, and others to eliminate developer friction, optimize resource utilization, and accelerate the release velocity of hundreds of engineers.
* Enterprise Kubernetes Stewardship: Serve as the ultimate authority on container orchestration, microservices deployment, and service mesh architectures. Drive high\-level initiatives to maximize Kubernetes cluster efficiency, auto\-scaling dynamics, secure multi\-tenancy, and immutable deployment patterns across the entire organization.
* Proactive Infrastructure Security \& Compliance: Partner closely with SecOps to architect a zero\-trust infrastructure fortress. Embed automated security guardrails and compliance controls into core Infrastructure\-as\-Code pipelines, ensuring seamless, continuous adherence to strict healthcare regulatory standards, including HIPAA and SOC 2 (Do good).
* Enterprise Triage \& Resilience Engineering: Act as the premier technical escalation authority for critical, cross\-system infrastructure failures. Spearhead complex, multi\-layered root\-cause analysis, lead deep\-dive post\-mortems, and champion engineering patterns that turn production incidents into systemic resilience upgrades.


**Technical Leadership \& Culture Multiplication**
* Engineering Force Multiplier: Act as a strategic force multiplier across the engineering ecosystem. Direct high\-impact cross\-functional initiatives, define and publish enterprise\-wide best practices, influence organizational technology roadmaps, and mentor senior and staff\-level engineers to foster an inclusive, collaborative culture of technical excellence (Have fun. Do good.).


**Role Requirements \& Qualifications Minimum Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline with an IT focus.
* Experience: 8\+ years of dedicated experience in cloud engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps roles.
* Engineering Tenure: 13–15\+ years of distinguished experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Architecture, or DevOps Platform Engineering, with a definitive track record of scaling high\-concurrency, enterprise cloud environments.
* AWS Architectural Authority: Deep, authoritative mastery of the AWS ecosystem (including EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, IAM, and advanced networking features) with proven experience executing massive scalability strategies and sophisticated cloud spend optimization structures.
* Advanced Platform Stack: Professional\-grade expertise architecting and managing production\-scale Kubernetes environments, comprehensive Datadog telemetry architectures, and modular Infrastructure\-as\-Code platforms utilizing Terraform or Terragrunt at scale.
* Strategic Engineering \& Tooling: Expert\-level software engineering capability in Python, Go, or Bash to construct intelligent automation engines, internal CLI tools, and infrastructure platforms that systematically eliminate operational toil.
* Executive\-Level Influence: Exceptional communication and advisory skills, with a proven ability to translate complex, low\-level technical trade\-offs into clear strategic visions for executive leadership while remaining capable of conducting a rigorous, line\-by\-line code and architecture review.

f35c397e.title: Director - Yield Architecture and Engineering
f35c397e.description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited
**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Hardware Engineering
**General Summary:**

We are seeking a strategic, technically credible, and people\-centered leader to serve as Director within the Yield Architecture and Engineering organization in Bangalore. This leader will build a strong, self\-reliant organization focused on Design for Yield, DFT partnership, silicon diagnostics, automation, and corrective and preventive action within those domains, under a clear local leadership and operating model.


The charter for this role is threefold. First, build and lead the Bangalore organization by attracting, retaining, developing, and inspiring exceptional engineering talent, while creating a healthy leadership bench and a durable succession pipeline. Second, establish the operating discipline, governance, and cross\-functional partnerships required to deliver a focused Bangalore charter across Design for Yield, DFT, diagnostics, automation, and domain\-specific CAPA. Third, grow Bangalore into a center of technical capability and innovation that can execute independently, partner globally, and contribute to the future of diagnostics, Design for Yield, automation, and AI\-enabled engineering.


This role requires more than technical management. The successful candidate will be a strong organizational leader who creates clarity, builds trust, develops future leaders, and establishes accountability across a distributed and cross\-functional environment. The Director will work closely with US technical leaders and partner organizations while taking direct responsibility for Bangalore team health, site capability, operating effectiveness, and delivery of the local charter.


**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 8\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 7\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
  

OR
  

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 6\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

**1\. People\-First Organization Leadership**
---------------------------------------------

Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing Bangalore engineering organization with a people\-first mindset. Create a culture of trust, inclusion, accountability, collaboration, and technical excellence. Establish clear expectations, invest in career development, recognize strong performance, address organizational friction, and ensure engineers have the leadership, support, and opportunities needed to succeed.


**2\. Talent, Retention, and Leadership Development**
-----------------------------------------------------

Own the talent system for the Bangalore organization, including hiring, onboarding, retention, capability development, succession planning, and leadership bench strength. Develop technical leaders and future people leaders who can independently own teams, programs, and organizational responsibilities. Create a sustainable organization that does not depend on continuous remote leadership for routine decisions, team development, or operational direction.


**3\. Focused Bangalore Design\-for\-Yield and Diagnostics Charter**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Establish and lead a focused Bangalore charter across Design for Yield, DFT partnership, silicon diagnostics, automation, and corrective and preventive action within those domains. Build an operating model that connects architecture, design, DFT, tapeout readiness, diagnostic readiness, diagnostic support for silicon bring\-up, and continuous improvement. Ensure that responsibilities, interfaces, decision rights, and outcomes are clearly defined across the covered lifecycle.


**4\. Production\-Quality Diagnostics Capability**
--------------------------------------------------

Build and sustain reliable, scalable, production\-quality scan and memory diagnostics capability across Qualcomm's product portfolio. Establish clear ownership for diagnostic readiness, execution, integration, quality, throughput, and continuous improvement. Balance immediate product commitments with the systematic improvements needed to strengthen diagnostic capability and prevent recurring execution gaps.


**5\. Technical Capability Building**
-------------------------------------

Build durable technical depth across diagnostics execution, diagnostics methodology, memory diagnostics, Design for Yield, DFT collaboration, automation, and related engineering disciplines. Identify capability gaps, establish development plans, hire critical expertise, and create mechanisms for knowledge transfer and reuse. Reduce dependence on tribal knowledge by promoting documented methods, reusable workflows, and shared technical standards.


**6\. Design for Yield and Cross\-Lifecycle Feedback**
------------------------------------------------------

Strengthen collaboration with Bangalore Design, DFT, Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Failure Analysis, and related engineering teams to move Design for Yield thinking earlier in the product lifecycle. Establish feedback and feedforward mechanisms that convert diagnostic and silicon findings into improved design practices, DFT readiness, diagnostic coverage, defect tolerance, manufacturability, and future product decisions.


**7\. Automation and AI\-Enabled Transformation**
-------------------------------------------------

Champion the thoughtful use of automation, analytics, and AI across Bangalore engineering workflows. Partner with Automation and AI technical leaders to reduce repetitive work, improve engineering productivity, accelerate design and diagnostic analysis, preserve organizational knowledge, and create scalable decision\-support capabilities. Ensure that automation and AI initiatives are tied to measurable engineering needs and integrated into sustainable operating processes.


**8\. Operational Excellence and Governance**
---------------------------------------------

Establish disciplined operating mechanisms across the Bangalore organization, including project plans, technical roadmaps, workforce reviews, operations reviews, metrics, decision rights, escalation paths, and accountable owners. Create transparent visibility into commitments, risks, dependencies, staffing, and capability gaps. Promote proactive planning and continuous improvement rather than recurring firefighting.


**9\. Cross\-Functional and Global Partnership**
------------------------------------------------

Build strong working relationships across Bangalore Design and DFT organizations and with global YAE, Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Failure Analysis, Automation, AI, manufacturing, and executive stakeholders. Clarify organizational interfaces, resolve cross\-functional barriers, and drive shared outcomes in Design for Yield, DFT, diagnostics, automation, and related CAPA through technical credibility, clear communication, and collaborative problem solving.


**10\. Site Capability and Organizational Stewardship**
-------------------------------------------------------

Serve as a visible leadership presence for the Bangalore organization. Take responsibility for team health, organizational stability, employee engagement, leadership effectiveness, and the long\-term growth of the site's capability. Represent Bangalore needs and opportunities in global planning while ensuring alignment with broader YAE and PPS priorities.


**11\. Strategic Planning and Resource Management**
---------------------------------------------------

Translate organizational priorities into a practical capability roadmap and staffing plan. Assess the required skills, current bench, critical gaps, and hiring sequence. Allocate resources according to business priority, technical risk, and team capacity while protecting mission\-critical delivery and investing in long\-term capability.


**12\. Innovation in Ambiguous Problem Spaces**
-----------------------------------------------

Lead effectively where the technical path, ownership model, or organizational boundaries are not yet fully defined. Bring structure to complex problems, develop options and tradeoffs, establish accountable ownership, and guide teams toward scalable solutions that support Qualcomm's emerging technologies and future business needs.


**Minimum Qualifications**
==========================

* Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or a related field and 8\+ years of ASIC design, DFT, silicon diagnostics, product engineering, test engineering, Design for Yield, validation, integration, or related work experience.

**OR**

* Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or a related field and 7\+ years of ASIC design, DFT, silicon diagnostics, product engineering, test engineering, Design for Yield, validation, integration, or related work experience.

**OR**

* PhD in Science, Engineering, or a related field and 6\+ years of ASIC design, DFT, silicon diagnostics, product engineering, test engineering, Design for Yield, validation, integration, or related work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

**1\. Education**
-----------------

Bachelor's or advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.


**2\. Semiconductor Engineering Experience**
--------------------------------------------

12\+ years of experience in semiconductor engineering, including experience in one or more of the following areas: Design for Yield, DFT, ATPG diagnostics, memory diagnostics, product engineering, test engineering, silicon diagnostics, failure analysis, or post\-silicon engineering.


**3\. Engineering Leadership Experience**
-----------------------------------------

5\+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical organizations, or major cross\-functional programs, with demonstrated success building capability and delivering results across functions or sites.


**4\. People Leadership Excellence**
------------------------------------

Demonstrated ability to lead with empathy, clarity, consistency, and accountability. Strong record of hiring and retaining talent, developing engineers, coaching managers and technical leaders, creating succession pipelines, and building a healthy culture in a high\-performance engineering environment.


**5\. Organization Building**
-----------------------------

Experience building or transforming an engineering team, site capability, or technical function. Demonstrated ability to establish a charter, define roles, build a leadership bench, close capability gaps, and create an organization that can operate with increasing independence.


**6\. Semiconductor Systems Perspective**
-----------------------------------------

Strong understanding of the semiconductor product lifecycle and the interactions among architecture, design, DFT, test, diagnostics, product engineering, failure analysis, manufacturing, and diagnostic/design feedback loops. Ability to connect diagnostic and Design for Yield feedback to operating accountability across these boundaries.


**7\. Diagnostics and Design\-for\-Yield Credibility**
------------------------------------------------------

Technical knowledge of silicon diagnostics, diagnostic readiness, Design for Yield, DFT, production\-quality diagnostic execution, or related post\-silicon disciplines. Ability to engage credibly with technical experts, evaluate engineering risks, and guide priorities without becoming a bottleneck for detailed execution.


**8\. Operational Leadership and Governance**
---------------------------------------------

Demonstrated success establishing operating mechanisms such as project plans, roadmaps, technical reviews, workforce reviews, metrics, decision frameworks, risk management, escalation paths, and continuous improvement practices.


**9\. Cross\-Functional Influence**
-----------------------------------

Proven ability to align teams with different priorities, responsibilities, and technical perspectives. Ability to influence decisions through credibility, structured communication, evidence, and collaborative problem solving.


**10\. Automation and AI Orientation**
--------------------------------------

Experience sponsoring, adopting, or scaling automation, analytics, software, or AI\-enabled engineering workflows. Ability to identify where technology can improve productivity, quality, knowledge retention, or technical decision\-making while partnering effectively with specialized Automation and AI teams.


**11\. Strategic and Systems Thinking**
---------------------------------------

Ability to translate broad organizational objectives into an executable charter, capability roadmap, staffing plan, operating model, and measurable outcomes. Demonstrated ability to balance immediate product delivery with longer\-term capability investment.


**12\. Leadership Under Ambiguity**
-----------------------------------

Demonstrated ability to create structure and direction when the technical solution, ownership boundaries, or organizational model are not fully defined. Comfortable leading complex initiatives that require experimentation, judgment, and coordination across multiple organizations.


**13\. Global Leadership and Communication**
--------------------------------------------

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience leading across geographic, functional, and cultural boundaries. Ability to represent the Bangalore organization effectively with technical leaders, partner organizations, and senior management.


**14\. Community Builder**
--------------------------

Demonstrated ability to create stability, trust, shared purpose, and deep collaboration across complex or evolving team environments.


**Applicants** : Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e\-mail disability\-accomodations@qualcomm.com or call Qualcomm's toll\-free number found here . Upon request, Qualcomm will provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities to be able participate in the hiring process. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. (Keep in mind that this email address is used to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. We will not respond here to requests for updates on applications or resume inquiries).


Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law.

Staffing and recruiting agencies and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited.
